quandoUsar: Yes-or-no market with play money, in demos, educational content, or games: price of each outcome, probability history, and a ticket with an estimated return.
When the person needs to read the history point by point, with a pointer or keyboard, and see the return update while typing the amount.
quandoEvitar: Use `line-chart` when you only need to show the historical series, or several series, without the purchase ticket.
Use `token-swap` to exchange one asset for another with rate and fee.
For real money the block is not enough: balance and position live only in local state and a rejected order returns to the start with no error message.

teclado.acao: On the focused chart, read the previous or next point of the series; the value read is announced.
On the chart, jump to the first or last point of the period.
In the period and outcome selectors (Yes and No), choose the neighboring option, move focus along, and wrap around at the ends.
Each selector is a single stop, on the chosen option, and the chart is another stop.

acessibilidade: The chart is a focusable `role="group"` whose `aria-label` gives the current probability and explains the arrow keys; the point read is announced by an `aria-live="polite"` region and the SVG is `aria-hidden`.
Period and outcome are `role="radiogroup"` with `role="radio"` buttons, `aria-checked`, and roving tabindex.

The amount field has a label, `aria-invalid` above the balance, and `aria-describedby` for the estimate; the buy button receives `aria-busy` while submitting and the position line is `aria-live="polite"`.
movimento: The line draws itself in 1.1 s the first time; switching period or outcome transforms the path on a spring that does not overshoot and the end marker slides to the new point, pulsing at rest.
Probability, prices, shares, return, and balance count up to each new value in 0.48 s, the selection pills slide, and the button label goes through “Placing order” and “Order placed”.
With “reduce motion” on, the numbers change instantly, the line appears without drawing or transformation, pills and marker jump, and the pulse and the submit indicator stop.
responsivo: The card goes up to 27rem; the chart has a fixed height of 136 px and a width measured by a `ResizeObserver`, and up to 26rem of viewport the inner padding shrinks.
notasIA: Import the named component `PredictionMarket` (the default export is the preview with example data) and control the outcome with `side` and `onSideChange` or use `defaultSide`.
In `ranges`, every period needs the same number of `points` (probability of “Yes”, from 0 to 1) and one `labels` item per point; the last point of the active period is the current price.
`onPlaceOrder(order)` receives `side`, `amount`, `price`, and `shares`: return a Promise to hold “Placing order” and show your own error if it rejects; `balance` is only the starting balance.
